name: preview_new_conversation
title: Preview texting a new number
description:
What texting a typed phone number would do, without sending anything: how the number reads
in the sending number's country, the exact text, and a `confirmation` code valid for 10
minutes for `start_conversation`.  A lead needs no preview: `start_conversation` takes
its `lead_id` directly.

phone.description: Without a +, read in the sending number's country.

body.description: The message, exactly as the customer should get it.
